description.fr: Budget mensuel personnel, 100 % local et hors ligne : plusieurs comptes protégés par un code, calendrier des prélèvements et des achats, prêts, calculatrice, personnalisation complète et sauvegarde automatique avant désinstallation. description.en: A personal monthly budget, 100% local and offline: several PIN-protected accounts, a calendar of charges and purchases, loans, a calculator, full personalization and an automatic backup before uninstalling. With Nebula News, a “Learn” card shows today’s finance articles, without ever sending anything from your budget. Explicitly not a banking app: no bank, no market data, no online account.
